clips.title: The story
paras: In the Wetlands, the Rod of Channeling is carried by Dragonmaw spellcasters. Warlocks seeking to summon a felhunter gather three for Strahad Farsan's acolytes to steady the ritual circle in Ratchet.

Warlocks need more than willpower to bind a volatile felhunter. Strahad Farsan asks for three matched rods so his acolytes can channel magic together and steady the summoning circle while the warlock binds the beast. Dragonmaw darkcasters carry these rods for their own workings. Bonewarders and shadowwarders bear them at Angerfang Encampment and in the surrounding Wetlands ruins. Combat leaves the rods worn and nicked, but they still focus chaotic nether energy.
